sources.title: High-Quality Biological Data Systems for Drug Discovery | Elucidata
sources.snippet: Elucidata helps pharma and biotech teams turn fragmented biological data into high-quality, structured systems - accelerating biomarker discovery, advancing target identification, and driving real progress in drug development.

sources.title: Elucidata - Polly Documentation
sources.snippet: Polly is an AI-enabled cloud platform that provides access to FAIR multi-omics data from public and proprietary sources. Data from across repositories, databases, and proprietary datasets is curated using ML models, ensuring that it is machine-actionable and analysis-ready.

sources.title: Omics Data Platform for Pharma: Scale & Automate | Elucidata Polly
sources.snippet: Scale R&D with Polly's omics data platform. Harmonize millions of datasets for AI-ready drug discovery and multi-omics analysis. Request a demo to find FAIR data.
